afriqa.source_split: official test; internal interface-only group separated by English passage title
afriqa.strata: three who, three when, three where, three other English question prefixes per language
afriqa.answer_contract: Explicit verbatim English passage span in every language; empty passage mandates JSON null. Cross-lingual comprehension/English extraction, not native-language answer production.
afriqa.gold_oracle: Published human English gold span verified at its official character offset; published human_translation query marker; no generated translations/labels.
afriqa.grouping: Each question/English passage title is one paired unit; titles are disjoint between internal dev and locked, and across selected languages. Yoruba/Swahili source questions differ, so cross-language raw accuracy is not a causal language comparison. Native-versus-English is paired within the same item.

languages: Yoruba only; Swahili absent in source snapshot
afrimcqa.source_split: Gold-bearing official development data only; official test hides labels and is not evaluated. Internal image-group-disjoint research holdout, not official test accuracy.
afrimcqa.gold_oracle: Published correct_en/correct_native plus paired wrong options; one fixed outcome-independent joint permutation. No manual translation or model judge.
afrimcqa.grouping: Each original image group is one paired unit; all conditions share the same frozen option order; dev and locked image IDs and decoded-pixel hashes are disjoint.

system_prompts.AfriQA:
You are doing source-constrained English extractive question answering.
Return a JSON object with exactly one key, "answer". Its value must be either a string copied verbatim from the supplied English passage, or null.
The question may be in Yoruba, Swahili, or English. In ALL cases the answer must be an English passage span; do not translate the answer into the question language.
Use only the supplied passage. If the passage is empty, you MUST return {"answer": null}, even if you know the answer. Do not add explanations, citations, or other keys.
system_prompts.Afri-MCQA:
Answer the multiple-choice question using the listed A-D options. Use the supplied image when an image is present. When no image is supplied, make your best choice from the question and options.
Return a JSON object with exactly one key, "answer", whose value is exactly one of "A", "B", "C", or "D". Do not translate options, add explanations, or output other keys.

execution_policy: GPU serialized by root; run only after root GO. No model-based prompt, item, threshold, condition, or recipe tuning. Preserve invalid responses/errors as failed observations; no answer repair or replacement items. Interface-dev rows are transport/schema checks, not outcome-based search. Any substantive amendment requires a new protocol before locked calls.
limits: Small selected published subsets; no population inference or universal cultural/linguistic ranking.
Public benchmark contamination in pretrained models is not excluded.
External native-speaker-authored cultural benchmark reuse is not new community validation by this project.
English instructions and source-span answers do not measure natural native-language service quality.
No new retrieval model, community intervention, or efficient learned evaluation algorithm is tested.
Model family, scale, quantization and backend differ; comparisons do not isolate model recency.
executor: Saurav K. Aryal, with Codex-assisted implementation and execution.
